missions.title: Where's Piet?
missions.intro: Auntie Faiza: "Piet didn't come home after school. He's a good boy, but he follows his friends. Please, ask around, check the courts and the fields. You walk further than I can."

objectives.text: Ask three people if they've seen Piet
Check the sand court in Westridge
Look at the soccer field in Lentegeur
Ask Kaylin Booysen: she plays there every day

missions.title: Quiet Eyes
missions.intro: Boeta: "Marlon Carelse is going to meet someone at the cafe. I want to know who. Follow him, but stay back. If he sees you, he stops talking."
missions.description: Follow Marlon to the cafe without losing him.

objectives.text: Follow Marlon Carelse to the cafe (by day, 09:00-18:00)

missions.title: Candles
missions.intro: Aunty Gadija: "Load-shedding again! I'm out of candles and the customers sit in the dark. Buy a box at Duin Spaza in Lentegeur, and bring it here when the lights go out."
missions.description: Bring candles during a power cut.

objectives.text: Buy candles at Duin Spaza in Lentegeur
Bring them to Gadija's spaza during load-shedding (19:00-21:00 on even days)
